description: Lower-case version of evalset-tinystories for proxy models with the default character tokenizer (space, a-z and . , ' ! ?). 20 prompts for greedy generation (64 positions each), 3 calibration prompts and passages for perplexity. A proxy is untrained: these results show that the flow runs, not that a model is accurate.
prompts: once upon a time
one day, a little girl named lily
tom had a big red ball
the cat was sad because
there was a small bird who
mom said to ben,
sara and her dog went to the park
the sun was hot and
a little boy found a box
once there was a happy frog
the old man had a garden
anna wanted to bake a cake
in the forest, there lived a bear
max did not like to share
the rain came down and
lucy saw a shiny star
the fish swam in the blue sea
tim was scared of the dark
the kids played with a kite
grandma gave sue a warm hug
calibration: once upon a time, there was a little dog named spot.
the girl and her mom went to the store to buy some bread.
ben liked to run fast. one day he fell down and cried.
passages: once upon a time, there was a little girl named lily. she loved to play outside with her friends. one day, she found a big red ball in the park.
tom had a toy car. he liked to play with it every day. one day, the car broke. tom was sad, but his dad fixed it.
the cat sat on the mat. it was a sunny day. the cat saw a bird and wanted to play with it, but the bird flew away.
